subject: Manipuri (Dance)
notes: Schools offer one style. Theory (30 marks, 2 hours) has no unit-wise split; practical is 70 marks.
Students are presumed to have preliminary training in the style.

chapters.name: Terms
topics: Nritta, nritya, natya, tandava, lasya, lokadharmi, natyadharmi; abhinaya; sangeet, tala, laya; rasa, sthayi and sanchari bhava

chapters.name: Manipuri Technical Terms
topics: Chali, bhangi, longlei, uplei; kartal, khubak isei and pung cholom; sankirtan; rajmel, menkup, tanchap; kinds of raas

chapters.name: Manipuri Costume and Make-up
topics: Potloi for Radha and gopis; Krishna's costume; Vaishnava tilak

chapters.name: Choloms
topics: Pung and kartal cholom in rajmel, menkup and tanchap

chapters.name: Bhangi Pareng
topics: Achouba and Goshtha Bhangi Pareng; Punglon Jagoi, Isei Jagoi; Khurumba Bhangi Pareng; Krishna and Radha Abhisar and Nartan; advanced cholom in char tal

chapters.name: Background Knowledge
topics: Nata Sankirtan, Ariba Pala, Lai Haraoba, the raas forms, Goshtha and Udukhal Leela; Gurus Amubi Singh, Atomba Singh, Amudon Sharma; Khamba and Thoibi
